name: Micro-Tremor Detection
description: Detects physiological micro-tremor in facial muscles — absent in AI-generated faces (Jain et al., 2022).
mechanism:
This method analyzes physiological micro-tremor for deepfake detection:

1. **Micro-동작추출**: Sub-pixel facial motion is extracted using phase-based video motion magnification or dense optical flow. The signals of interest are involuntary physiological tremors — oscillatory motions at frequencies above voluntary control (4-12 Hz).

2. **PhysiologicalTremor감지**: All living humans exhibit physiological tremor (8-12 Hz) caused by motor unit firing and stretch reflex oscillation. The method searches for this characteristic frequency in facial motion signals. Deepfake videos generated without physiological modeling lack this biological signal.

3. **공간적Tremor일관성**: Physiological tremor affects the entire body coherently — all facial points should show correlated tremor at similar frequencies. The method checks spatial coherence of detected high-frequency motion. AI generation may produce spatially incoherent micro-motion (independent per-region noise) rather than the coherent biological tremor.

4. **Tremor주파수안정성**: Physiological tremor frequency is relatively stable for an individual over short periods but varies naturally within the 8-12 Hz band. The method analyzes tremor frequency stability — completely stable frequency (single spectral line) or no detectable tremor peak both indicate non-biological origin.

5. **TremorAmplitude평가**: Physiological tremor amplitude is typically 50-200 μm (sub-pixel in most video). The method uses motion magnification to assess whether the detected tremor amplitude falls within physiological ranges. Absent tremor, excessive tremor, or tremor with wrong spectral shape indicates deepfake generation.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
